en_lines: Jed was a pilot at a big airport.
sentences.zh: 傑德是一位在大機場工作的飛行員。

en_lines: He flew the work planes.
sentences.zh: 他負責駕駛工作飛機。

en_lines: They were kept in the big sheds by the runway.
sentences.zh: 那些飛機停放在跑道旁的大棚子裡。

en_lines: One day, Jed got a call
from a man at the airport.
sentences.zh: 有一天，傑德接到機場一位先生打來的電話。

en_lines: “Please come now in your little plane.
sentences.zh: 「請你現在開著你的小飛機過來。」

en_lines: We need you to help us.”
sentences.zh: 「我們需要你來幫忙。」

en_lines: Jed started up
the engine.
sentences.zh: 傑德發動了引擎。

en_lines: The little plane went slowly
down the runway
and stopped by the big planes.
sentences.zh: 小飛機慢慢地滑過跑道，停在大飛機旁邊。

en_lines: The big planes looked down
at the little work plane and laughed.
sentences.zh: 大飛機們低頭看著這架小小的工作飛機，笑了起來。

en_lines: “You will have to get
out of our way,” they said.
sentences.zh: 「你得讓開，別擋我們的路。」他們說。

en_lines: “We are going to take off soon.”
sentences.zh: 「我們馬上就要起飛了。」

en_lines: A man came running
over to the little plane.
sentences.zh: 一位先生朝著小飛機跑了過來。

en_lines: He gave Jed two big bags.
sentences.zh: 他交給傑德兩個大袋子。

en_lines: “Take these bags up to the farm
on the big hill,” said the man.
sentences.zh: 「請把這些袋子送到大山丘上的農場。」那位先生說。

en_lines: “There is so much snow up there
that the farmer can’t get out.
sentences.zh: 「那裡的雪太厚了，農夫沒辦法出來。」

en_lines: He needs this food for his family.”
sentences.zh: 「他需要這些食物給他的家人。」

en_lines: Jed pulled the bags of food
into the little plane,
and it moved slowly
down the runway.
sentences.zh: 傑德把裝著食物的袋子拉進小飛機裡，小飛機便慢慢地滑向跑道。

en_lines: The little plane went faster and faster.
sentences.zh: 小飛機跑得越來越快。

en_lines: Then away it went up into the sky.
sentences.zh: 接著牠就飛上了天空。

en_lines: It went out over all the houses
and the farms.
sentences.zh: 牠飛過了所有的房子和農田。

en_lines: Soon it came to the big hills.
sentences.zh: 很快牠就來到了那些大山丘。

en_lines: There was snow all over them.
sentences.zh: 山丘上到處都是雪。

en_lines: “I hope I can find the farm,”
said Jed.
sentences.zh: 「希望我能找到那座農場。」傑德說。

en_lines: The little plane flew
around the hills again and again.
sentences.zh: 小飛機在山丘上空一圈又一圈地飛。

en_lines: Jed looked for the farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 傑德尋找著那間農舍。

en_lines: Then he saw it.
sentences.zh: 然後他看見了。

en_lines: The farmer was outside.
sentences.zh: 農夫就在屋外。

en_lines: He was waving to the little plane.
sentences.zh: 他正對著小飛機揮手。

en_lines: “That looks like the place,”
shouted Jed.
sentences.zh: 「那裡看起來就是了！」傑德大喊。

en_lines: Jed pushed the bags of food out.
sentences.zh: 傑德把裝著食物的袋子推了出去。

en_lines: They fell down
into the snow by the farmer.
sentences.zh: 袋子落進了農夫身旁的雪地裡。

en_lines: “Good work!” shouted the farmer.
sentences.zh: 「做得好！」農夫大喊。

en_lines: And the little plane
flew back to the airport.
sentences.zh: 接著小飛機就飛回機場了。

en_lines: The little plane went slowly
past the big planes.
sentences.zh: 小飛機慢慢地經過那些大飛機。

en_lines: “I did a very good job today,”
said the little plane.
sentences.zh: 「我今天做得很棒。」小飛機說。

en_lines: “I helped someone who needed me.”
sentences.zh: 「我幫助了需要我的人。」
